name: Vince Haley
current_role: Director of the Domestic Policy Council (since January 2025)
summary: Vince Haley directs the White House Domestic Policy Council. Trump’s campaign speechwriter, he helped lead speechwriting in the first term, and was named domestic policy chief in November 2024, working on the policy team under Stephen Miller.
